g.text: C3 transfers in direction; chemokine contrasts depend on sampling context
One point per donor; bars = donor means, not confidence intervals. External strata match location, protocol and assay.
Cells and nuclei are separate: CXCL2 reverses in the nuclear subset. Lower values indicate adventitial enrichment.
